## Dataset citations

| File this repo fetches | Upstream attribution (not a license grant from this project) |
| --- | --- |
| `card.dta` | Card (1995); labeled "Public domain" in the `causaldata` docs, not a grant here. NLS Young Men extract. |
| `cps_mixtape.dta` | Dehejia and Wahba (1999); labeled "Public domain" there. CPS extract. |
| `nsw_mixtape.dta` | LaLonde (1986) / NSW experiment. Cite the paper. |
| `lmb-data.dta` | Lee, Moretti, and Butler (2004), *QJE* 119(3): 807–859. |
| `castle.dta` | Cheng and Hoekstra (2013), *JHR* 48(3): 821–854. FBI UCR plus law dates. |
| `abortion.dta` | Donohue and Levitt (2001). Cite the paper. |
| `texas.dta` | Texas prison synthetic control. Cite the Mixtape code repository (https://github.com/scunning1975/mixtape) and the series source used there (`python/synth_1.py`, `Do/synth_1.do`: black male prisoners (per capita), `bmprison`). Do not invent a public-domain claim. |
| `sasp_panel.dta` | Cunningham and Kendall, Survey of Adult Service Providers. Panel of recent client sessions, used in the first-edition panel chapter. Fetched as `sasp_panel.dta` from the Mixtape code repository. Not a license grant from this project. |
